title: Uruguayan Almond Cake
description: A moist and flavorful cake from Uruguay, made with ground almonds and a hint of creamy texture. Perfect for a special occasion or dessert.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and bake mix-ins.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and vanilla extract.
Add the ground almonds to the egg mixture and whisk until well combined.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture and mix until just combined.
Divide the batter evenly between the prepared pans.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let the cakes cool in the pans for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
If using cheese, crumble it on top of one of the cooled cakes before serving.
